claims.explanation: PD-123319 is an AT2 receptor antagonist; its selective toxicity likely reflects dependence of some cancer lines on AT2-mediated bradykinin/NO/cGMP signaling. High expression of AGTR2 and downstream BDKRB2/NOS3/GUCY1A1/PRKG1 would sensitize, while NRF2 pathway mutations (NFE2L2, KEAP1) protect by mitigating oxidative stress. Other sensitizing mutations (STK11, RB1, PTEN, NF1) may amplify this pathway.
